section: Enabling the manual approval gate controller
job_statement: When I need to implement manual approval gates in my CI/CD pipelines, I want to enable the manual approval gate controller, so I can pause pipeline execution until authorized users provide approval.
prerequisites: Have administrator permissions for openshift-pipelines namespace
Have logged in using oc CLI
related_jobs: Specify manual approval tasks in pipelines
desired_outcomes: Minimize time required to enable approval functionality
Ensure controller is properly installed and ready
evidence: using-manual-approval-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Enabling the manual approval gate controller, lines 86-136
notes: Core prerequisite job for manual approval workflow. Technology Preview feature.

section: Enabling the manual approval gate controller - UI method
job_statement: When I need to enable the manual approval gate controller as a platform administrator, I want to apply the ManualApprovalGate custom resource using the oc CLI, so I can activate approval task functionality in my cluster.
parent_job: Enable the manual approval gate controller
desired_outcomes: Minimize configuration errors through simple YAML manifest
Ensure READY status is True within reasonable time
evidence: using-manual-approval-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Enabling the manual approval gate controller, lines 101-134
notes: Procedural approach using CLI. Includes verification step to confirm READY status.

job_statement: When I need to implement governance gates in my deployment pipeline, I want to specify manual approval tasks at critical stages, so I can ensure only authorized stakeholders can advance pipeline execution to production.
prerequisites: Create groups and add required users (for group approval)
desired_outcomes: Ensure required number of approvals before proceeding
evidence: using-manual-approval-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Specifying a manual approval task, lines 142-377
notes: Core configuration job. Supports individual users, groups, and mixed approval strategies. Multiple examples show different approval patterns.

section: Specifying a manual approval task - Basic deployment pipeline
job_statement: When I need to add approval gates to my deployment pipeline as a CI/CD engineer, I want to specify an ApprovalTask in my Pipeline definition with approvers and approval thresholds, so I can control progression from test to production deployment.
parent_job: Specify manual approval tasks in pipelines
related_jobs: Configure status fields for approval tracking
desired_outcomes: Provide clear approval context via description field
evidence: using-manual-approval-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Specifying a manual approval task, lines 157-200
notes: Basic approval task configuration showing build->test->approval->deploy flow. Uses user list and numberOfApprovalsRequired parameter.

section: Specifying a manual approval task - With status tracking
job_statement: When I need to track the approval lifecycle during pipeline execution as a CI/CD engineer, I want to specify status fields for approval tasks, so I can monitor approval state, approver responses, and progress toward required approvals.
parent_job: Specify manual approval tasks in pipelines
related_jobs: Monitor approval task status via web console
Monitor approval task status via CLI
evidence: using-manual-approval-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Specifying a manual approval task, lines 202-261
notes: Shows status tracking fields: state, approvers, approvalsRequired, approvalsReceived, approversResponse, startTime. Includes parameter reference table.

section: Specifying a manual approval task - Multi-user approval
job_statement: When I need multiple stakeholders to approve a deployment as a CI/CD engineer, I want to configure approval tasks with multiple individual users and a required approval count, so I can implement quorum-based authorization.
parent_job: Specify manual approval tasks in pipelines
desired_outcomes: Ensure no single approver can authorize critical deployments
Support flexible approval thresholds (not all approvers required)
evidence: using-manual-approval-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Specifying a manual approval task, lines 265-301
notes: Example shows 3 users with numberOfApprovalsRequired: 2, implementing quorum approval.

section: Specifying a manual approval task - Group-based approval
job_statement: When I need teams to approve deployments as a CI/CD engineer, I want to configure approval tasks with OpenShift groups, so I can delegate approval responsibility to teams without managing individual user lists.
parent_job: Specify manual approval tasks in pipelines
desired_outcomes: Reduce configuration changes when team membership changes
evidence: using-manual-approval-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Specifying a manual approval task, lines 303-338
notes: Example shows group:qa-team and group:security-team with numberOfApprovalsRequired: 2. Groups must be created before use.

section: Specifying a manual approval task - Mixed user and group approval
job_statement: When I need both individual and team-based approval as a CI/CD engineer, I want to configure approval tasks with a mix of users and groups, so I can implement complex approval policies requiring sign-off from specific roles and teams.
parent_job: Specify manual approval tasks in pipelines
desired_outcomes: Ensure flexible approval policies (tech lead + team member)
Minimize configuration complexity while supporting complex authorization patterns
evidence: using-manual-approval-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Specifying a manual approval task, lines 340-377
notes: Example shows tech_lead (individual) + group:qa-team + group:security-team with numberOfApprovalsRequired: 2. Enables patterns like 'tech lead OR (QA + security)'.

job_statement: When my pipeline reaches an approval task as an authorized approver, I want to review and approve or reject the task, so I can control whether the pipeline proceeds to the next stage.
prerequisites: User listed as approver in task configuration
Access to web console or opc CLI
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to review and respond to approval requests
Ensure clear understanding of what is being approved
Support rejection when deployment should not proceed
evidence: using-manual-approval-self-managed-reduced.adoc -> Approving a manual approval task, lines 386-399
notes: Core execution job. Can approve via web console or opc CLI. Rejection causes pipeline failure. User can change approval to rejection before threshold is met.

section: Approving a manual approval task by using the web console

desired_outcomes: Minimize time to respond to approval notifications
Provide context (description field) for approval decision

notes: Procedural approach for web console. Multiple navigation paths: notification, Pipelines->Approvals tab, PipelineRun details. Requires console plugin enabled.

section: Approving a manual approval task by using the command line

desired_outcomes: Minimize time to approve tasks in automated workflows

notes: Procedural approach using opc CLI. Commands: list, describe, approve, reject. Supports optional -m message parameter.

desired_outcomes: Minimize confusion about group approval behavior
Reduce likelihood of misconfigured approval policies
Understand how group state changes based on member approvals
